page.running_head: ARM ARN ARO ARP ARR ART ARS

main_text.p: ARMVS pecudis offerebatur sub lege & sacerdoti dabatur, Leuitic.7.32.&c.& 8,25,26. & 9,21,& 10,14.Num.6 19. & 18.18. Deut.18. 3. Ezech. 24. 4. Armus Sauli reseruatus, 1. Sam. 9. 24.
ARNON torrens celebris,Nu.21,13. &c. Deut.2 24 &c.Iof.12, 1.2.& 13,9.16. Iudic.11,13,18, 22.2. Reg.10.33 Esai.16,2.
[AROER, oppidum, cuius frequens mentio, Num.32. 34. Deut.2.36. Iosu.12. 12. Iudic. 11.26.2. Reg. 10.33.1. Chr. 5. 8. Esai.17.2. Ierem.48 19.
AROMATA, ad cibum,ad corporis ornatum,ad sacrificia, & ad funerum medicationem conducentia, Gen.37,25. & 50, 26.Exo.31,11. 2.Reg.20.13. 2.Para.16,14.Ester. 2. 12. Cant. 3,6, Marc.16,1. Ioan.19.40.
ARPHAXAD patriarcha,Gen.10.22,24.Luc.3.35.] filius Sem, i.sanans vastationem.
ARRHABO,Vide PIGNVS, Arrhabo Spiritus,2. Cor. 1. 22. & 5.5.Vide PIGNVS,& SPIRITVS Sanctus.

ARROGANTIA ὑπερηφανία est per quâ temeritas atque impudentia vrnam sibi comparat authoritatem Iacob.4.16. Gloriamini de arrogantia vestra: o mnis eiusmodi gloriatio mala est, 1. Ioh. 2. 16.Fastus vitę, non est ex patre, sed ex mundo&c.

ARROGANTIA vitanda,Rom.12.16. Exempla: Cain, Genes.4. 9.Simeon & Leui,34.30. Pharao,Exod.5 2.&15.9.Goliath, 1.Sam.17.v.4.8.Roboam,2,Paral.10.14. Nabuchodonosor, Daniel,3.14. Iudæi, Ioan.18.30.Pilatus, 19.10. summus Sacerdos,Act.5.28.Herodes,12.23. Antichristus, 2 Thess.2.4. Vide Rom.1 30 2.Tim.3.2.

ARTAXERXES,Longimanus, Rex Persarum , accipit literas plenas querelis aduersus Iudæos, 1.Esdr.4.v.7.17.respondet,iubens ædificationem Templi impediri, 4. 21. [Artaxerxes Mnemō,Esdr. 6.14.Nehem.2.1.& 5.4.& 13.6.]permittit, 7.1. &c.Esdram ducem Israelis constituit, 7.21. se Regem Regum venditat,v.12.
ARS, τέχνη, est cuiusque rei scientia, usu, vel traditione,vel ratione percepta, tendens ad usum aliquem vitæ necessarium.
